# Commands

Every `fobis` command, by area. Each page lists all the options of the command (generated from the command
line itself); `fobis <command> --help` prints the same. The [fobos file](/fobos/) holds the settings a command
reads from the project, the [user configuration](./configuration) those of the machine.

## Building

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build`](./build) | Build all programs found or specific target(s). |
| [`clean`](./clean) | Clean project: remove all OBJs and MODs files. Use carefully. |
| [`run`](./run) | Build a target (if needed) and execute it. |
| [`install`](./install) | Install previously built files, or clone+build+install a GitHub-hosted FoBiS project. |
| [`rule`](./rule) | Execute special rules or user-defined ones from a fobos file. |
| [`introspect`](./introspect) | Emit machine-readable JSON project metadata. |
| [`tree`](./tree) | Print the resolved inter-project dependency tree. |
| [`check`](./check) | Validate the dependency graph without building. |

## Dependencies and projects

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`new`](./new) | Create a project: a module in src/, a program in app/, a test in test/, a fobos with debug and release modes and a [test] section, a .gitignore and a git repository (nothing committed). An existing file is never overwritten. |
| [`fetch`](./fetch) | Fetch and build GitHub-hosted Fortran dependencies listed in the fobos [dependencies] section. |
| [`fpm`](./fpm) | Interoperate with the Fortran Package Manager: fpm.toml to fobos and back. |
| [`scaffold`](./scaffold) | Manage project boilerplate via bundled scaffold templates. |
| [`ecosystem`](./ecosystem) | Manage a set of interconnected FoBiS projects (registry: [ecosystem] in the user config). |

## Packages and indexes

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`index`](./index-command) | Manage the package indexes searched by search, info and add (several side by side, none by default). |
| [`search`](./search) | Search the configured package indexes (and the indexes they follow). |
| [`info`](./info) | Show what a package's source holds: versions, build system, modules, licence. |
| [`add`](./add) | Add a dependency to the fobos, resolved through the package indexes (the fobos gets its URL). |
| [`remove`](./remove) | Remove a dependency from the fobos (and the recipe fobis add copied for it), or from fpm.toml. |
| [`publish`](./publish) | Publish the current project: a release archive for static hosting, an entry of an index. |
| [`pkg`](./pkg) | Packages built for your compiler and installed in a store (install, list, uninstall, upgrade, path). |
| [`audit`](./audit) | Report the advisories that affect the fetched dependencies (exit 1 when one does). |

## Testing

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`test`](./test) | Discover, build, and run Fortran test programs. |
| [`doctests`](./doctests) | Test all valid doctests snippets found. |
| [`coverage`](./coverage) | Generate HTML/XML coverage reports from instrumented test runs. |

## Verifying results

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`case`](./case) | Run the cases declared in the fobos ([case:NAME]) and extract their quantities. |
| [`provenance`](./provenance) | Print what a result produced now would depend on: commit, dependency pins, compiler, flags, machine. |
| [`verify`](./verify) | Run cases and compare their quantities with the stored references, within each quantity's tolerance. |
| [`matrix`](./matrix) | Build, test (and verify) every mode x shadow combination available on this machine. |
| [`assess`](./assess) | Assess the numerical error and uncertainty of a case's quantities from ensembles of its variants. |
| [`diff-run`](./diff-run) | Run the cases on a revision and on the working tree, in scratch copies, and compare their quantities. |
| [`bench`](./bench) | Measure the run time of cases: warm-up, then runs until the median's 95% interval is narrow enough; compared with the case's recorded history or, with --compare, with a revision. Faster or slower only when the intervals do not overlap. |
| [`gate`](./gate) | One verdict for a change: build, review of the changed lines, tests, verify, diff-run and bench against the base, assessment budgets and the declared matrix, each reduced to pass/fail/skipped with its first failing fact. Exit 1 when a non-advisory stage fails. |
| [`profile`](./profile) | Profile a case: where it spends its time (gprof), its instructions (callgrind) or its GPU time and transfers (nsys), mapped to the project's procedures and source lines. |

## Code analysis

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`lint`](./lint) | Report bug-prone and obsolescent Fortran constructs (rules: fobis lint --list-rules). |
| [`review`](./review) | Report the lint findings on the changed lines only (staged, since a base, or uncommitted). |
| [`query`](./query) | Answer a question about the code from the analysis: who calls what, who writes a variable, where a name is defined, which directive regions hold a line, where a variable lives on the device, which MPI calls are made. |
| [`modernize`](./modernize) | Apply the automatic lint fixes (array constructors, relational operators, generic intrinsics, character length, labelled DO loops) to a scratch copy and keep them only when it builds, the tests still pass and the declared cases give equivalent results; each rule is checked alone when the whole set fails. |
| [`bindings`](./bindings) | Generate bind(c) shims (NAME_c.f90), a C header (NAME.h) and a Python ctypes wrapper (NAME.py) for the public procedures of the modules whose arguments allow it; report why the others are not bound. |
| [`agents-md`](./agents-md) | Generate the build, test and verification instructions for coding agents (AGENTS.md) from the fobos and the sources, between fobis:begin/end markers: the rest of the file is kept. |

## AI assistance

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`llm`](./llm) | Manage the local LLM: models pulled from the Hugging Face Hub (nothing is downloaded implicitly). |
| [`ask`](./ask) | Answer a question from the knowledge packs (and, with --project, the project's procedures), citing sources. |
| [`kb`](./kb) | Search the knowledge packs (Fortran, OpenMP, OpenACC, MPI references; your own packs). |
| [`testgen`](./testgen) | Generate a test program for a module's public procedures; kept only when it builds, runs and checks. |
| [`merge-assist`](./merge-assist) | Propose resolutions for merge, rebase or cherry-pick conflicts, checked by the compiler; never stages. |
| [`commit`](./commit) | Generate a Conventional Commits message for staged changes via a local LLM. |
| [`mcp`](./mcp) | Serve lint, rules, knowledge packs and build commands to MCP clients over stdio. |
